text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَءَاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَىٰهَا وَلَٰكِنْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنِّى لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ

words.gloss_range: opening connector that resumes or coordinates the prior judgment scene into a counterfactual divine response
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as a hinge from the preceding plea into divine speech. It can coordinate with the judgment scene or resume it, but either way the counterfactual that follows arrives without a narrated pause. The repeated connector sound also marks the ayah's turns: opening counterfactual, adversative decree, and final coordinated population.

topics.headline: opening connector answers the prior scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah answers the criminals' prior plea directly instead of beginning an unrelated saying.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) as a conjunction linking to prior discourse, and the clause evidence places the next words inside the counterfactual protasis.

topics.headline: coordination and resumption remain live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both continuity with 32:12 and the force of a fresh divine ruling.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction can carry either continuation or resumptive force without conflict in this discourse position.

topics.headline: repeated connector creates audible turns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening connector is heard together with the counterfactual particle and later connector points.
topics.reason: The surface form binds the connector to the following conditional particle, while later connectors mark further clause turns.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual conditional particle that frames universal guidance as an unrealized divine possibility
words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) makes the first clause counterfactual: divine willing and universal guidance are grammatically possible, but not the enacted reality. Its scope reaches through the lām-marked result before the adversative pivot exits the hypothetical frame. The reader first feels divine capacity, then the closure of that unrealized alternative.

topics.headline: perfect verb under counterfactual condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that universal guidance is framed as a foreclosed divine possibility, not as a denied ability.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) as a conditional particle, and attachment evidence marks words 1-3 as the counterfactual protasis.

topics.headline: scope ends before adversative reality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first completes the hypothetical result, then overturns any inference with the real decree.
topics.reason: The clause evidence separates the conditional protasis and apodosis from the later contrast clause.

topics.headline: petition shifts into foreclosed grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from the prior request for future action into grammar that marks the alternative as already closed.
topics.reason: The boundary row connects the criminals' prior request with the counterfactual grammar in this ayah.

words.gloss_range: divine willing in a perfect first-plural counterfactual condition, presenting universal guidance as dependent on an unrealized act of will
words.root_gloss_range: willing and thingness; locally the verb selects volition, while thingness remains ontological pressure rather than a separate local sense
words.prose: {{ar:شِئْنَا}} ({{tr:shiʾnā}}) locates the decisive condition in divine will. The perfect first-plural form does not narrate an enacted willing; under the counterfactual particle, it marks a settled unrealized condition. The root's link between willing and thingness gives the counterfactual weight: universal guidance could have become real through will, but the ayah says that act of will was not enacted. The recurrence of this divine-capacity formula (6:111, 10:99, 16:9) and the medial glottal stop make the halt both formulaic and audible. The plural capacity voice later gives way to singular source and oath, so the reader hears a shift from possible capacity to realized decree.

topics.headline: perfect first-plural will is counterfactual
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the will verb affirms divine capacity while marking this universal guidance as a non-enacted condition.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a perfect first-person plural verb, and the attachment evidence places it inside the counterfactual protasis.

topics.headline: will precedes the guidance gift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is not self-generated by every soul but depends on prior divine agency.
topics.reason: The local clause orders willing before the giving verb and its guidance object.

topics.headline: thingness pressure remains under volition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine will is presented as reality-making power, while the local verb still means willing.
topics.reason: The root relation supports ontological pressure, but local morphology and syntax select the volition verb rather than a noun of thingness.

topics.headline: recurring capacity formula has audible arrest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this as part of a recurring divine-capacity formula (6:111, 10:99, 16:9) whose sound also catches at the glottal stop.
topics.reason: The supplied rows give concrete formula references (6:111, 10:99, 16:9) and surface features of the local verb.

topics.headline: plural capacity anticipates singular oath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the speaker shift from first-plural capacity to first-singular source and oath later in the ayah.
topics.reason: The implicit subject evidence marks this verb as first plural, while later {{ar:مِنِّي}} ({{tr:minnī}}) and {{ar:أَمْلَأَنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾamlaʾanna}}) are first singular.

words.gloss_range: apodosis lām that marks the certain result inside the unrealized counterfactual condition
words.prose: This {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the answer-marker for the counterfactual condition. It locks the hypothetical willing to its result, so the giving clause is not a loose wish but the formal consequence that would have followed. Its force differs from the later oath lām: this one certifies what would have been, while the later one certifies what will be sworn.

topics.headline: lām completes the conditional architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the giving clause is grammatically tied as the result of the unrealized condition.
topics.reason: QAC identifies lām jawāb law, and attachment evidence marks words 4-8 as the apodosis.

topics.headline: same surface differs from oath lām
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's shift from conditional certainty to sworn certainty through repeated lām sounds.
topics.reason: The two particles share a surface form, but QAC distinguishes word 4 as apodosis lām and word 14 as oath lām.

topics.headline: bound lām is heard with the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the result-marker is fused to the coming giving verb in recitation.
topics.reason: The particle is proclitic to the following verb in the local surface sequence.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual Form IV giving or caused delivery, with every soul as recipient and its guidance as the transferred object
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, and giving; locally Form IV selects caused arrival or bestowal inside a counterfactual gift frame
words.prose: {{ar:آتَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ʾātaynā}}) is the giving verb inside the unrealized result. Its Form IV shape makes guidance a caused arrival or delivered gift, and its double-object frame holds both the recipient set and the guidance given. The perfect form remains counterfactual inside that frame, so the word describes what would certainly have been delivered, not what actually occurred. Same-surah giving language later grants scripture to Musa (32:23), and wider gift uses include scripture, wisdom, and mercy (2:87, 2:269, 18:65), sharpening the contrast between specific granted gifts and this unrealized universal gift.

topics.headline: perfect giving remains unrealized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the gift is certain only inside the counterfactual result, not in actual narration.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect, but attachment evidence places it in the lām-marked apodosis of an unrealized condition.

topics.headline: recipient and gift are compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance as an object delivered to every individual recipient.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) as the first object and {{ar:هُدَاهَا}} ({{tr:hudāhā}}) as the second object.

topics.headline: coming root narrows to caused delivery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance would be made to arrive by divine agency, while local Form IV keeps the meaning in bestowal rather than simple coming.
topics.reason: The root range includes coming, but the Form IV local verb selects caused arrival or giving.

topics.headline: suffix sustains plural capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same first-plural voice carrying both willing and giving before the later singular oath.
topics.reason: The implicit-subject evidence links this first-plural verb to the preceding first-plural will verb.

topics.headline: universal gift contrasts granted scripture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unrealized universal gift contrasts same-surah granted scripture to Musa (32:23) and belongs to a wider class of divine bestowals such as scripture, wisdom, and mercy (2:87, 2:269, 18:65).
topics.reason: The supplied rows give the same-surah reference (32:23) and broader gift-class parallels (2:87, 2:269, 18:65) while the local grammar keeps the gift counterfactual.

words.gloss_range: accusative construct totalizer making every individual soul the recipient scope of the hypothetical gift
words.root_gloss_range: totality, completion, encompassing, and encircling; locally selected as exhaustive distributive scope through a singular genitive complement
words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) turns the recipient phrase into total scope. As an accusative construct head, it is governed by the giving verb while its genitive complement defines the set: every soul, counted one by one. The encircling root pressure fits the word's work here, enclosing the recipient field without remainder. This opening totality later answers the final totalizer, so the ayah is bookended by universal scope.

topics.headline: accusative construct marks recipient totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hypothetical gift targets every individual soul through a structured construct phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) as the first object and construct head governing {{ar:نَفْسٍ}} ({{tr:nafsin}}).

topics.headline: totalizer removes exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the counterfactual is not national, tribal, or partial; it imagines every soul receiving its own guidance.
topics.reason: The singular complement under the totalizer and the later possessive guidance suffix preserve individualized scope.

topics.headline: encircling image supports totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices totality as an enclosing force, while local grammar keeps the word functioning as a quantifier.
topics.reason: The root image supports the totalizer's exhaustive work without replacing the local quantifier sense.

topics.headline: opening totality mirrors final totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's scope frame: every soul in the counterfactual opening and all together in the sworn closure.
topics.reason: The critical rows and attachment evidence connect opening individual totality with final collective totality.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular soul or self under universal scope, individuating each morally responsive recipient
words.root_gloss_range: breath, self, soul, appetite, and preciousness; locally selected as an individuated moral self within universal scope
words.prose: {{ar:نَفْسٍ}} ({{tr:nafsin}}) is the singular, indefinite complement that lets the totalizer distribute guidance across every possible self. Its genitive case is internal to the construct phrase, not direct government by the giving verb. The root field gives the recipient more than a body label: breath, selfhood, desire, and moral value all gather into the soul that would have received its own guidance. The phrase also absorbs the criminals' prior collective plea into a wider rule about every soul.

topics.headline: singular under totalizer individuates every soul
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices universal scope as one-by-one inclusion rather than an anonymous mass.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive and indefinite, and attachment evidence makes it the complement of the construct totalizer.

topics.headline: genitive comes from construct relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipient phrase is internally built before it enters the giving frame.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:نَفْسٍ}} ({{tr:nafsin}}) as the genitive complement of {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}).

topics.headline: breath and selfhood pressure the recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipient is a morally responsive self, while local grammar keeps the noun in the singular category of soul.
topics.reason: The root range supports breath, selfhood, and appetite, but the local construct phrase selects the countable soul or self.

topics.headline: every-soul formula broadens the plea
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior criminals' collective voice is absorbed into a universal soul formula also seen in judgment contexts (3:25, 3:185, 21:35).
topics.reason: The supplied rows give concrete formula references (3:25, 3:185, 21:35) and same-surah accountability links.

words.gloss_range: possessed guidance as the second object of the giving verb, individualized for each soul in the counterfactual frame
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, leading, directing, and gift-giving pressure; locally selected as guidance delivered as a possessed object
words.prose: {{ar:هُدَاهَا}} ({{tr:hudāhā}}) is the guidance object that would have been given. The feminine suffix returns to the singular soul, making the imagined guidance individualized rather than generic. As a verbal noun in the second-object slot, guidance becomes transferable in the syntax; the gift branch of the root is therefore felt through the giving construction, while the local sense remains guidance. The word also pulls the surah's guidance thread back into a counterfactual form, including the earlier guidance mention at 32:3.

topics.headline: suffix returns guidance to each soul
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the counterfactual guidance is each soul's own guidance, not a single undifferentiated abstraction.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the possessive suffix as referring back to {{ar:نَفْسٍ}} ({{tr:nafsin}}) inside the construct phrase.

topics.headline: guidance is the transferable second object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is syntactically treated as something that could be bestowed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:هُدَاهَا}} ({{tr:hudāhā}}) the second object of the giving verb.

topics.headline: gift pressure survives through the giving verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance as bestowed direction, while local grammar keeps guidance as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The giving construction licenses gift pressure, but the local headword remains the guidance verbal noun.

topics.headline: guidance thread becomes counterfactual
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the surah's guidance language returning in unrealized form, including the earlier guidance mention (32:3) and guidance-giving parallels (20:50, 87:3).
topics.reason: The critical rows give concrete references (32:3, 20:50, 87:3) and connect the word to the prior plea and guidance thread.

words.gloss_range: conjunctive element fused with the adversative particle, pivoting from counterfactual guidance to decree
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not simply add another clause; fused with the adversative that follows, it forms the pivot out of the hypothetical. It preserves linkage to the first half while preventing the decree clause from being read as apposition to the counterfactual gift. The repeated connector sound also mirrors the ayah's opening hinge.

topics.headline: connector fuses into adversative transition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah turns from possibility to reality through a compound adversative transition.
topics.reason: QAC states that the conjunction is fused with {{ar:لَكِنْ}} ({{tr:lākin}}) to form the adversative transition.

topics.headline: coordination remains while correction begins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the decree is connected to the counterfactual yet syntactically blocks a continuation of it.
topics.reason: The clause evidence marks a contrast clause after the conditional apodosis.

topics.headline: second connector mirrors the opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the audible return of the connector at the ayah's central pivot.
topics.reason: The sound row points to a concrete repetition of the same connector surface.

words.gloss_range: light adversative particle introducing a verbal decree clause that corrects the inference from the counterfactual
words.prose: {{ar:لَكِنْ}} ({{tr:lākin}}) is the ayah's central adversative hinge. Its light form introduces a verbal sentence rather than governing a noun like the heavy form. The particle corrects the inference that divine ability entails universal guidance: instead, the fulfilled word from the speaker governs reality. Structurally it creates the middle beat between counterfactual possibility and sworn filling.

topics.headline: light form opens a verbal sentence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the adversative introduces a verbal decree clause rather than a noun-governing construction.
topics.reason: QAC marks a light adversative particle introducing the following verbal sentence.

topics.headline: adversative corrects possible inference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not deny divine capacity; it corrects the conclusion one might draw from that capacity.
topics.reason: The contrast clause follows the completed counterfactual giving clause and introduces the realized decree.

topics.headline: middle beat of ayah architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's movement from possibility to decree to oath.
topics.reason: The clause structure shows the adversative clause standing between the counterfactual opening and the oath-content clause.

words.gloss_range: perfect becoming-true or being-binding of the decree, with the saying as subject
words.root_gloss_range: truth, rightness, reality, confirmation, and obligation; locally selected as the decree becoming binding and fulfilled
words.prose: {{ar:حَقَّ}} ({{tr:ḥaqqa}}) makes the saying a realized and binding fact. It agrees with the following definite saying as its subject, so the word is not a generic truth noun floating by itself; it is the event of the decree becoming true. The root gathers truth, right, reality, and obligation into one pressure, while Form I keeps the sense as becoming true rather than causing truth. The formula echoes decree-fulfillment language (36:7, 46:18) and in this surah shifts truth from revelation's attribute (32:3) to a decree event.

topics.headline: perfect verb with saying as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the decree as already fulfilled or binding, not merely announced as future possibility.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:ٱلْقَوْلُ}} ({{tr:al-qawlu}}) as the subject of {{ar:حَقَّ}} ({{tr:ḥaqqa}}).

topics.headline: truth and obligation collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine word is true, right, real, and binding at once.
topics.reason: The root range supports the convergence of truth, rightness, reality, and obligation in the local decree frame.

topics.headline: Form I is becoming true
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices realization rather than causation as the local verbal force.
topics.reason: The local form supports intransitive becoming true with the saying as subject, not a causative making-true construction.

topics.headline: decree formula echoes fulfillment language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a familiar decree-fulfillment formula (36:7, 46:18) and a same-surah shift from revelation truth (32:3) to decree truth.
topics.reason: The critical rows give concrete formula references (36:7, 46:18) and a same-surah contrast (32:3).

words.gloss_range: the definite saying or decree that acts as subject of becoming true and whose content is the following oath
words.root_gloss_range: saying, utterance, speech-act, report, and decree; locally selected as a definite performative decree-product
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَوْلُ}} ({{tr:al-qawlu}}) is the grammatical subject that has become true. The article treats it as a known decree, not a new indefinite statement. The speech root moves from utterance to performative decree: this is not merely a report about what will happen, but a word whose content is carried by the following oath clause. Against the prior human plea, the ayah places decisive agency in prior divine speech.

topics.headline: decree is subject of becoming true
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the decree itself acts grammatically as the realized subject.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:ٱلْقَوْلُ}} ({{tr:al-qawlu}}) the subject of {{ar:حَقَّ}} ({{tr:ḥaqqa}}).

topics.headline: definite article presupposes decree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the saying is treated as a recognized decree rather than a newly introduced utterance.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verbal noun as definite with the article.

topics.headline: speech functions as decree-product
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from human plea speech to divine speech that performs and fixes reality.
topics.reason: The speech root is locally bound to the fulfilled decree clause and the oath-content complement.

topics.headline: middle decree clause leads to oath content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the middle decree clause pivots from counterfactual guidance to the sworn filling content.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the oath clause as content complement of the saying.

words.gloss_range: source phrase with first-singular suffix, marking the decree as from the divine speaker and closing the decree clause
words.prose: {{ar:مِنِّي}} ({{tr:minnī}}) marks source, not spatial motion. The saying is from the first-person singular speaker, and the pronoun shift moves the ayah from the plural capacity of willing and giving into singular realization. As the last word of the decree clause, it closes the source statement before the oath content begins.

topics.headline: source phrase marks divine origin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the decree's authority is sourced directly in the divine speaker.
topics.reason: QAC identifies preposition plus first-singular suffix as source or origin, and cross-reference evidence ties the suffix to the divine speaker.

topics.headline: speaker shifts from We to Me
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the turn from plural divine capacity in the counterfactual to singular divine ownership of the realized decree.
topics.reason: Earlier verbs carry first-plural subjects, while this suffix and the oath verb carry first singular reference.

topics.headline: source phrase closes decree clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the decree's source is stated before the oath content unfolds.
topics.reason: Clause evidence ends the contrast clause at word 13 and begins the oath-content clause at word 14.

words.gloss_range: oath lām introducing the sworn content of the decree and scoping through the final totality
words.prose: This second {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is oath lām. It introduces the content that the decree carries and scopes over the emphatic filling verb through the final totality. The same surface sound now does different work from the earlier apodosis lām: the ayah moves from what would have happened to what is sworn to happen.

topics.headline: oath lām scopes to the end
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole filling clause is oath-content, not just the next verb.
topics.reason: QAC identifies lām al-qasam and clause evidence makes words 14-21 the content complement of the decree.

topics.headline: second lām shifts certainty type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from hypothetical certainty to sworn certainty.
topics.reason: The two lām particles have different grammatical functions in QAC: answer to counterfactual at word 4 and oath marker at word 14.

topics.headline: oath marker fuses to emphatic verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices oath force entering audibly before the heavy energetic verb is complete.
topics.reason: The oath marker is proclitic to the following verb, which carries heavy energetic nūn.

words.gloss_range: first-singular active filling oath with heavy energetic ending, selecting Jahannam as container and the following phrase as composition or population
words.root_gloss_range: filling, fullness, occupying a container, and assembly that fills space; locally selected as active filling under oath
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْلَأَنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾamlaʾanna}}) is the oath's main action: the first-singular speaker will fill. The active subject continues the preceding source phrase, and the verb takes Jahannam as the container object with the following prepositional phrase naming the filling population. Heavy energetic nūn makes the future oath grammatically and audibly locked. The root's fullness image is local and concrete here, while its assembly branch adds pressure because the filling is done with gathered moral populations. The phrase participates in a repeated filling-of-Jahannam oath formula (7:18, 11:119, 38:85).

topics.headline: active divine speaker fills
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the oath is active first-person divine action, not a passive outcome.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks a first-singular implicit subject for the oath verb.

topics.headline: verb selects container plus population phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Jahannam as the container and jinn-humans as the filling domain.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:جَهَنَّمَ}} ({{tr:jahannama}}) as object and the {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) phrase as complement.

topics.headline: heavy nūn locks the oath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the future filling as emphatically certain in grammar and sound.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an imperfect first-singular verb with heavy energetic nūn after oath lām.

topics.headline: assembly branch pressures the filling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that filling and assembled population reinforce each other, while the local verb still selects actual filling.
topics.reason: The root range includes assembly, but the local verb frame selects filling a container with a specified population.

topics.headline: filling Jahannam formula recurs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this local oath as part of a repeated judgment formula (7:18, 11:119, 38:85), while the local form remains the emphatic first-singular filling verb.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete formula references (7:18, 11:119, 38:85) and form-specific notes for the local oath verb.

words.gloss_range: proper-name object of the filling oath, functioning as the fixed bounded place to be filled
words.root_gloss_range: proper-name field with foreign/diptote marking and depth or containment pressure; locally selected as the named object-container
words.prose: {{ar:جَهَنَّمَ}} ({{tr:jahannama}}) is the object filled by the oath verb. Its proper-name force keeps the referent fixed, while the accusative diptote form marks objecthood without ordinary tanwīn. Depth and valley traditions can add container pressure, but the local grammar already makes the name the bounded place to be filled. Its pairing with the filling oath belongs to a repeated formula (7:18, 11:119, 38:85), and the heavy doubled middle suits the word's role as the oath's dense container.

topics.headline: Jahannam is the filled object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the named place as a bounded container within the filling oath.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:جَهَنَّمَ}} ({{tr:jahannama}}) as the direct object of the filling verb.

topics.headline: proper foreign name remains fixed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is not a generic container term but a fixed proper name with marked morphology.
topics.reason: QAC classifies the word as a foreign proper noun and notes its accusative diptote behavior.

topics.headline: depth imagery supports containment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices spatial depth and containment pressure, while the local word remains the proper name.
topics.reason: Possible topographical or depth background can support the local container role but does not replace the proper-name reading.

topics.headline: proper name belongs to filling formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the object as part of the recurring filling formula (7:18, 11:119, 38:85), with sound density matching its role.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete formula references (7:18, 11:119, 38:85) and surface sound evidence.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the two coordinated classes as the filling's source-domain, partitive range, or composition phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) opens the phrase that names what the filling consists of or is drawn from. Its governance reaches through the coordinated hidden and human classes, not only the first noun. The preposition keeps partitive and explanatory readings live, while the final totalizer presses the phrase toward comprehensive composition. Because the phrase comes after the named container, the population specification is delayed until Jahannam has been named.

topics.headline: preposition governs both coordinated classes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that jinn and humans share the same filling relation under one preposition.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence governs {{ar:ٱلْجِنَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-jinnati}}) by {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) and coordinates {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) under the same phrase.

topics.headline: partitive and composition readings remain live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both from-among and consisting-of pressure, with the final totalizer pushing toward full composition.
topics.reason: QAC allows partitive or explanatory function, while the final totality word emphasizes comprehensive inclusion.

topics.headline: population named after container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the oath names the container first, then reveals the ordered population phrase.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase follows the object {{ar:جَهَنَّمَ}} ({{tr:jahannama}}) and flows into the two-class population.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive collective for the concealed jinn class, first member of the final accountable-population pair
words.root_gloss_range: covering and concealment, yielding hidden beings, covered gardens, shields, covered reason, and concealed fetus; locally selected as concealed beings, not garden
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجِنَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-jinnati}}) names the hidden class as a definite collective under the preposition. It is not a new subject; it is part of the filling domain, paired with humans and sealed by the final totalizer. The root's concealment field makes the class label meaningful: hidden beings stand first, then the visible human class completes the taxonomy. Garden and other concealment branches remain real root pressure, especially with garden language later in the surah (32:19), but the local branch is concealed beings in a punishment context.

topics.headline: definite collective governed by preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the jinn as a known collective class within the filling phrase, not as counted individuals or a new subject.
topics.reason: QAC marks definite genitive noun, and attachment evidence governs it by {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}).

topics.headline: concealment root selects hidden beings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hidden side of moral agency, while local grammar selects the jinn branch rather than every concealment derivative.
topics.reason: The root range supports broad concealment pressure, but the local noun is the definite collective for concealed beings.

topics.headline: hidden class opens accountable pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final population as an ordered hidden-and-visible taxonomy of accountable beings.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the jinn and humans under one phrase and the critical rows note the established pair.

topics.headline: garden branch contrasts later reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a root-level contrast with garden language later in the surah (32:19), while the local word still names concealed beings.
topics.reason: The same root can produce garden language, and the source row supplies 32:19 as contrast; local grammar selects the jinn class.

words.gloss_range: strict coordination joining humans to jinn under the same prepositional filling phrase
words.prose: The final {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the human class onto the jinn class inside the same prepositional phrase. It is not sequential and not explanatory apposition; it makes two distinct classes share one filling relation. The small connector also makes the hidden-visible pair audible as a taxonomy before the final totalizer seals it.

topics.headline: humans join jinn under one phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two coordinated classes sharing the same prepositional role.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) as conjoined to {{ar:ٱلْجِنَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-jinnati}}) under {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}).

topics.headline: connector creates moral population pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hidden and familiar classes side by side in recitation and meaning.
topics.reason: The conjunction sits between the two collective nouns and makes the binary pair audible.

topics.headline: coordination blocks apposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices humans are not an explanation of jinn but a paired counterpart.
topics.reason: The explicit conjunction licenses coordination between separate classes.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive collective for humankind, coordinated with the jinn as the visible or familiar side of the final accountable pair
words.root_gloss_range: familiarity, sociability, perception, and human collectivity; a disputed forgetfulness derivation remains interpretive pressure but does not replace the aligned root locally
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) is the human class coordinated under the same preposition as the jinn. Parallel definiteness and genitive governance make humans the visible counterpart in one known class-pair. The aligned root field gives familiarity, sociability, and perception pressure beside the concealed jinn; a disputed forgetfulness derivation sharpens the human portrait without replacing the local root alignment. The recurring jinn-human accountable formula is explicit in parallels (6:112, 7:179, 55:33), and the term also echoes the surah's human creation language (32:7), moving from human origin to human inclusion in the eschatological decree.

topics.headline: human class shares governance and definiteness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices humankind as a known collective class paired grammatically with the jinn.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite genitive noun, and attachment evidence coordinates it with {{ar:ٱلْجِنَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-jinnati}}).

topics.headline: familiar and perceivable side of the pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices humans as the familiar and perceivable counterpart to the concealed class.
topics.reason: The aligned root supports familiarity and perception pressure, while the local noun remains the collective human class.

topics.headline: forgetfulness derivation remains pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a secondary human portrait of forgetfulness, while the aligned local root keeps familiarity as the main root field.
topics.reason: The bundle aligns the word to {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}), so the forgetfulness derivation survives only as contested pressure.

topics.headline: formula echoes accountable pair and creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recurring jinn-human accountable pair (6:112, 7:179, 55:33) and the same-surah movement from human creation (32:7) to human judgment.
topics.reason: The source rows give concrete formula references (6:112, 7:179, 55:33) and a same-surah creation echo (32:7).

words.gloss_range: accusative plural totalizer emphasizing complete inclusion of the coordinated jinn-human population
words.root_gloss_range: gathering, collecting, joining dispersed parts, and totality; locally selected as emphatic gathered completeness
words.prose: {{ar:أَجْمَعِينَ}} ({{tr:ajmaʿīna}}) closes the ayah by sealing the coordinated jinn-human phrase with total inclusion. Its accusative form can be read as semantic emphasis or circumstantial totality, but either way it removes exception. The gathering root makes the two classes converge into one outcome, and the selected plural totalizer is stronger than a generic togetherness word. It also answers the opening totality: every soul could have been guided, and the final population is gathered altogether under the decree.

topics.headline: final word removes exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final jinn-human phrase sealed as complete inclusion without exception.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as accusative totality or emphasis, and attachment evidence ties it to the jinn-human span.

topics.headline: gathering root collects the pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two named classes converted into one gathered moral population.
topics.reason: The root field supports gathering, and the masculine plural form fits the mixed rational classes.

topics.headline: chosen totalizer is not generic gathering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the selected form as a dedicated emphatic totalizer, while local syntax keeps it dependent on the population phrase.
topics.reason: The rows distinguish the selected plural totalizer from other gathering forms without making those other forms locally active.

topics.headline: closing totality returns to opening totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah bookended by totality: every soul in the unrealized guidance frame and all together in the decree closure.
topics.reason: The supplied rows connect the final totalizer to opening {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}), and the final sound closes the ayah.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual willing-and-giving clause is opposed by the binding word and its filling consequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first half presents an unrealized causal route able to distribute a fitting orientation to every individual self. The adversative then replaces possible direct allotment with an utterance whose obligation is already fixed and therefore moves toward execution.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward bringing a thing about supplies the unrealized causal operator.
Giving or delivering supplies the mode by which guidance would reach each recipient.
Total enclosure of the parts makes the counterfactual scope exceptionless.
The identity of a thing in itself individuates the universal scope one self at a time.
Gentle direction toward a path or truth defines what direct allotment would supply.
Fixed obligation converts the second clause from possibility into a due consequence.
An uttered proposition supplies the content whose consequence is to be enacted.

changed_reading.before: God could guide everyone but instead decrees punishment.
changed_reading.after: The verse contrasts two efficacies: an unrealized will that could directly allot orientation to every individual, and a binding utterance already moving into execution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence moves from every singular self to a vessel filled with concealed and manifest populations all together.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening distributes guidance across separate selves; the ending reverses that granularity by aggregating two opposed modes of presence and completing the vessel without residual capacity. The punishment clause therefore changes not only destination but social scale and spatial form.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive totality first ranges over recipients distributively.
Each self as a distinct identity is the unit that the opening keeps separate.
Occupancy equal to a container's measure makes the ending a capacity-closing operation.
Concealment supplies one mode of population entering the aggregate.
Manifest humanity contrasted with the concealed supplies the other mode of population.
Completion without separation or loss seals the aggregate after filling.

changed_reading.after: The verse reverses individualized address into a completely aggregated concealed-and-manifest population, with filling understood as elimination of every remaining gap.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word becomes due immediately before the first-person pledge to fill.
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth, signification, definition, and vessel-capacity align speech with measure. The word is not merely a prior prediction; its semantic boundary becomes materially true through complete occupation of the named receptacle.

activation_trace.role: Fixity matching reality supplies the transition from saying to realized state.
A thing fitting its proper place adds a material measure to fulfillment.
A thing's saying as its indication lets the consequence display what the word means.
The proposition as a defining limit supplies the boundary that execution realizes.
Filling to the vessel's measure turns semantic fulfillment into spatial completion.
Wholeness without missing parts marks the word's execution as complete.

changed_reading.before: A prior sentence predicts a later punishment.
changed_reading.after: The word acquires measure and volume: its defining content becomes true when the named vessel reaches complete occupancy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier truth is routed through warning to a people so that they may come to guidance; the focus counterfactual would bypass warning, uptake, and delay by directly giving every self its guidance. This distinguishes mediated address from irresistible installation.

activation_trace.role: Direct giving is the focus mechanism against which mediation is measured.
Direction toward truth names the outcome common to both routes.
Truth fixed against fabrication supplies the message that enters mediation.
Warning awakens caution and functions as the intermediate activator of response.
Possible arrival at guidance closes the mediated sequence without making uptake automatic.

structural_cues: 32:3 orders truth, warning, and then hoped-for guidance; 32:13 counterfactually skips the middle steps.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning before hoped-for guidance and direct giving in the focus; I infer that the counterfactual names an irresistible bypass of an actual mediated process. A live alternative is that both clauses describe one divine guidance at different scales.

changed_reading.before: The focus simply says that guidance was withheld.
changed_reading.after: The focus distinguishes directly installed universal guidance from an actual warning-mediated path whose uptake remains open.

context_deltas.mechanism: The created human is already formed and furnished with hearing, sight, and inward perception, yet response is described as little. The split mapping from the focus word to the smallness root activates a scalar reversal: sparse responsive gratitude precedes a consequence described by total filling. The focus counterfactual is therefore not repair of missing equipment but replacement of under-responsive use.

activation_trace.role: Creative bringing-into-being establishes that the recipient itself is intentionally furnished.
Making the faculties supplies their deliberate installation rather than accidental possession.
Hearing as understanding and compliance provides one existing channel for responsive guidance.
Inner discernment provides a second existing channel beyond bare visual sensation.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies a center where received guidance could become response.
Smallness marks the actual response as scarce despite the installed channels.
A branch of swelling abundance makes the stated paucity of gratitude an image of underfilling.
The authorized split-root smallness echo carries the earlier scarcity into the binding-word clause.
Complete filling reverses the earlier scalar deficit at the level of consequence.

structural_cues: 32:7-9 moves from formed creation through installed faculties to little gratitude; 32:13 moves from the split-root smallness echo to filling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies complete endowment, scarce gratitude, the split mapped root, and later filling; I infer a deficit-to-capacity reversal and not an etymological identity between saying and smallness. The live alternative is that the scalar echo is accidental and only the faculty-response contrast should remain.

changed_reading.before: Universal guidance would supply a capacity humans otherwise lack.
changed_reading.after: Humans already possess receptive channels; universal direct guidance would override their sparse use, while the focus turns the deficit of response into fullness of consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, seeing and hearing finally yield certainty and a request to return for fitting action. The repeated counterfactual opening then makes universal guidance include the unavailable retroactive timeline they request; the binding word closes that timeline rather than denying that certainty has arrived.

activation_trace.role: Actual sight supplies the first component of a certainty that arrives too late.
Hearing as comprehension and compliance makes the requested second chance behaviorally meaningful.
Returning from a wrong supplies the temporal reversal the speakers request.
Intentional action names what they claim the reopened interval would change.
Rectitude opposed to corruption supplies the proposed new quality of action.
Knowledge fixed beyond doubt establishes that epistemic guidance has finally occurred.
The now-binding obligation blocks conversion of late certainty into a reopened probation.
The uttered word functions as the temporal closure against the requested return.

structural_cues: The two adjacent verses open with matching counterfactual constructions: seeing the late scene, then willing universal guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies late perception, certainty, requested return, and the adjacent binding word; I infer that the word closes retroactive moral time. A live alternative is that the adjacency only contrasts human request with divine power without specifying a temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Universal guidance is an abstract hypothetical about present belief.
changed_reading.after: Universal guidance also names the impossible retroactive conversion of late certainty into timely action; the binding word closes that alternate history.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forgetting the encounter is answered by reciprocal abandonment and experienced consequence, whereas reminder produces immediate bodily descent and submission. Guidance is activated as remembered relation embodied in posture, not merely information stored in a self.

activation_trace.role: A way, bearing, and directed course lets guidance include enacted orientation.
Leaving something unattended supplies both the failed relation and its reciprocal consequence.
Experiential testing turns the consequence from reported information into embodied knowledge.
Audible, unsettled falling makes reminder produce an immediate bodily vector.
Lowering and submission give that bodily vector its relational meaning.

structural_cues: 32:14 repeats forgetting as act and consequence; 32:15 switches to reminder and immediate bodily descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the forget/remember polarity and opposite embodied outcomes; I infer a responsive circuit linking memory to posture. A live alternative is that these are adjacent reward-punishment scenes without a shared guidance mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Giving each self guidance would place correct information inside it.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be a maintained remembrance that reorients the body and relation; universal direct guidance would make that responsive circuit automatic.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two phases coexist. Before the greater punishment, the nearer punishment can still induce return from a wrong; after entry into the fire's enclosure, inhabitants repeatedly will an exit but are returned inside. Creaturely will therefore remains operative as desire while losing power to open the filled container.

activation_trace.role: Effective divine willing supplies the power against which later creaturely willing is contrasted.
A container brought to capacity supplies the final enclosed state.
Creaturely willing initiates each attempted exit but cannot complete it.
Passage beyond an interior supplies the desired route that the system blocks.
Return after an attempted departure closes each exit into a repeating loop.
The nearer or lower punishment marks a phase before final enclosure.
Return from a wrong preserves a corrective possibility in the earlier phase.
Greater magnitude distinguishes the final phase from its corrective precursor.

structural_cues: 32:20 iterates attempted exit and forced return; 32:21 places possible moral return before the greater punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two kinds of return, two punishment scales, and blocked repeated exits; I infer a temporal threshold joining them to the focus filling. A live alternative is that the nearer and greater punishments are contrasted without defining stages of one process.

Actual guidance thus has a distributed topology of gift, durable inscription, exemplar, and transmission; direct allotment to every self would bypass that chain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the authorized smallness-root mapping of the focus word and its large-jar branch as a material analogy. It remains anchored by the immediate filling verb and the focus's fit-and-completion branches. Render as a packet-induced container image for fulfillment, not as the lexical meaning of the word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The binding word stands directly before filling, and its non-dominant mapped inventory contains a large vessel.

activation_trace.role: A large jar supplies the strange material body imagined for the binding word.
A thing fitting its place or vessel connects becoming true with proper capacity.

changed_reading.before: The word is an immaterial sentence followed by a separate punishment.
changed_reading.after: The split-root branch lets the word behave experimentally like a jar whose promised content becomes true by being filled to capacity.

strongest_changes: Direct universal allotment now contrasts with warning-mediated uptake and with a later book-to-leader guidance chain.
Late certainty cannot reopen moral time, while nearer punishment still permits return before final enclosure turns attempted exits into return loops.
Destroyed dwellings can themselves guide later walkers, and routed water makes guidance legible as life-bearing flow into barren recipients.
Sparse use of endowed faculties is answered by fullness of consequence, and final opening paradoxically closes benefit and respite.
summary.what_was_special: The focus repeatedly changed through reversals of scale and state: individual versus aggregate, sparse response versus full capacity, gentle direction versus coercive alignment, late seeing versus closed time, and fertile inflow versus punitive filling. Split mapped roots remained live but explicitly contained.
remaining_uncertainties: The hydraulic model may be a functional guidance analogy or only a neighboring image of provision and revival.
The split-root smallness and breaking shadows are packet-authorized but too form-distant to state without explicit qualification.
The context leaves open whether the binding word's irreversible threshold precedes the nearer corrective punishment or only the greater enclosure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The counterfactual separates possible guidance from the order actually made firm.** `ء ت ي:B002` supplies granting, `ه د ي:B001` gentle direction to the destination, and `ح ق ق:B002` a due or binding obligation. The *law ... la-* frame grants guidance to every soul as a stated possibility, whereas *walakin ḥaqqa al-qawlu* turns to the realized order. The packet gives those two clauses; **the inferred arrow is:** universal granting is within power -> its non-occurrence cannot diagnose incapacity -> the binding word governs the disclosed outcome. This changes the reading from failed guidance to a deliberate contrast between two causal orders.

2. **The terminal image is fullness calibrated to a container.** `م ل ء:B001` is fullness matching what a vessel can hold, while `ج م ع:B009` gives wholeness or allness in *ajmaʿīn*. The emphatic *la-amlaʾanna* and final all-inclusive term reinforce one another. **Inferred arrow:** a binding word -> comprehensive gathering -> a filled endpoint with no merely incidental occupants. “Fill” functions as completed consequence, not as a loose synonym for placing some beings inside.

3. **Hidden and visible agents are gathered under one accountable total.** `ج ن ن:B005` identifies hidden jinn against the basal concealment image of `ج ن ن:B001`; the coordinated *al-jinnati wa-al-nāsi* is then closed by `ج م ع:B009`. Within the window, 32:12 exposes human self-witness and 32:17 will keep reward hidden from every soul. **Inferred arrow:** difference in present visibility -> no difference in inclusion at the final gathering. The paired categories make accountability cross the hidden/manifest boundary rather than depend on what human perception can presently inspect.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 32:17 complicated the hidden/visible total in 32:13: not only hidden agents but hidden recompense lies beyond present inspection. Then 32:18's denied equality showed that the comprehensive filling is one differentiated endpoint, not evidence that every gathered soul receives the same outcome.

baseline.text: Dileseydik her cana doğru yolu verirdik. Fakat Benim sözüm gerçekleşti: 'Cehennemi cinlerin ve insanların tamamıyla dolduracağım.'

findings.text: Her cana doğru yolun verilebileceği karşıt ihtimal, bunun gerçekleşmemesini güç yetmezliğinden ayırır ve gerçekleşen sonucu bağlayıcı sözün düzenine bağlar.
Bağlayıcı sözden doldurmaya ve bütünü toplamaya ilerleyen anlatım, Cehennemin gelişigüzel kişiler içeren bir yer değil, belirlenmiş sonucuna tam ulaşan bir kap olduğunu gösterir.
Cinlerle insanların birlikte anılması, görünürlük farkının son hesapta kapsanma farkı oluşturmadığını; gizli ve görünür varlıkların aynı sorumluluk toplamına girdiğini gösterir.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The gathering of devils and humans around Hell extends the focus's all-inclusive final-judgment setting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Every person will come to Hell, providing a broad universal frame for the focus's announced filling of it.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Guidance belongs to God rather than human choice alone, supporting the focus's contrast between possible and given guidance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Had God willed, He could have made people one community, a close counterfactual-will parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalın çekirdeğini gelme ve ulaşma olarak doğrular; kolaylık niteliği açıklamalardan yalnız birinde belirgindir. Gelmeyi isteme ise dalın genel anlamı değil, ayrı bir kalıpta görülen kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek anlam gelme ve ulaşmadır; gelmeyi isteme yalnız ilgili kalıba bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın gelme anlamı ile birini gecikmiş sayıp gelmesini istemeyi bildiren kalıp birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin ya da şeyin bulunduğu yere gelmesi veya bir hedefe ulaşmasıdır; bazı kullanımlarda bu gelişin kolayca gerçekleştiği belirtilir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şey gelir veya bir hedefe ulaşır.
Bir açıklamada gelişin kolaylıkla gerçekleşmesi özellikle belirtilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gelme ve ulaşma çekirdeğinde birleşir; kolaylık, çekirdeği sınırlamayan ek bir niteleme olarak görünür.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi veya şeyin bir yere gelişi ya da hedefe varışı anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gelme ve bir hedefe ulaşma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişinin bulunduğu yere gelişi söz konusu olduğunda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin bir hedefe doğru gelip ulaşmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişi dışındaki şeylerin gelişi ile daha genel ulaşma kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişi veya şeyin gelmesini ve bir hedefe ulaşmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kaynak kartlarındaki çekirdek ve kapsam bakımından anlamlı bir sınır farkı yoktur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; en doğrudan eş anlamlı karşılık yayımlandı, diğerleri geliş senaryosunu paylaşsa da çekirdeği keskinleştirmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: المجيء والوصول بالذات أو بالأمر أو بالتدبير، وطلب الإتيان أو وقوع الأمر المتوقع
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الإعطاء ولا الخراج ولا ريع الزرع

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi doğrudan verme anlamını ve ikincil olarak bir şeyi getirip hazır etme kullanımını bildirir. Bu iki geçişli kullanım dal çerçevesiyle uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gelme eylemini değil, bir alıcıya verme veya bir şeyi getirip sunma eylemini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın fiilin verme ve getirip sunma kapsamıyla sınırlıdır; vergi ya da başka bir kalıp anlamı içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi birine vermek; ayrıca bir şeyi getirip hazır ederek karşı tarafa sunmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir şey bir alıcıya verilir.
Bir şey getirilip hazır edilerek karşı tarafa sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek vermedir; bir açıklama aynı biçimin bir şeyi getirip hazır etme kullanımını da kapsadığını gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin alıcıya geçirilmesi veya getirilerek onun önüne konması anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Verme çekirdeğini ve getirip sunma uzantısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesne veya yararın doğrudan bir alıcıya aktarılması bağlamında en doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi alıcıya aktarma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi getirip hazır ederek sunma uzantısını belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Verme eylemi bir isteğe bağlı olmadan da gerçekleşebilir ve getirip sunma kullanımını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle kendisinden istenen bir şeyi verme durumunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir şey bir alıcıya verilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel verme alanına sahipken komşu dal alıcının istemiş olması koşuluyla daha dardır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; istek üzerine verme dalı en yakın sınır karşılaştırmasını sağladı.
branches.what_is_ar: الإعطاء، وإتيان الشيء بالشيء أو إحضاره
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد المجيء ولا الإتاوة المفروضة
branches.source_phrase_ar: آتى يؤتي إيتاء في معنى أعطى (jamhara)؛ آتاه إيتاء أي أعطاه وآتاه أيضا أي أتى به (sihah)؛ الإتياء الإعطاء (tahdhib)؛ الإيتاء الإعطاء (mufradat;maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir işe uygun yönünden yaklaşmayı, birine uyup razı olmayı, bir şeyin elverişli hale gelmesini ve ihtiyacı incelikle yürütmeyi birlikte destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tek bir yalın anlama indirgenmez; yaklaşım, uyum, elverişlilik ve ihtiyacı usulünce yürütme kullanımları ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Biçimlere bağlı yaklaşım ve uyum anlamları ile iki ayrı kalıptaki elverişlilik ve incelikli yürütme anlamları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi uygun yönünden ele almak, bir kimseye bir işte uyup razı olmak veya bir şeyin yapılabilir hale gelmesidir. İhtiyacı usulünce ve incelikle yürütme de bu alandaki ayrı bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Bir işe sonuç alınabilecek uygun yönünden yaklaşılır.
Bir kimseye belirli bir işte uyulur ve onun isteğine razı olunur.
Bir şey kişi için elverişli ve yapılabilir hale gelir.
Bir ihtiyaç uygun yol gözetilerek incelikle yürütülür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, uygun yoldan yaklaşma çevresinde uyma, elverişli hale gelme ve ihtiyacı incelikle yürütme kullanımlarını bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.text: uygun yoldan ele almak ve elverişli hale gelmek
concept_gloss.applicability: İşin uygun yönü, kişiler arası uyum veya bir şeyin yapılabilir hale gelişi birlikte temsil edileceğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uygun yaklaşım, uyum ve elverişlilik eksenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin kişi için yapılabilir veya mümkün hale gelmesini anlatan kalıpta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyin elverişli hale gelişi anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Uygun yönden yaklaşma, kişiye uyma ve ihtiyacı incelikle yürütme kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: işin uygun yönü ve tutulacak yolu
bir şeyin ona elverişli hale gelmesi
ihtiyacını uygun yoldan ve incelikle yürütmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal uygun yönden yaklaşmayı, birine uymayı ve ihtiyacı incelikle yürütmeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal güçlüğün kalkıp genel olarak kolaylığın ortaya çıkmasını merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir işin yapılabilir ve elverişli hale gelmesini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak elverişlilik alanına rağmen odak dal yöntem ve uyum ilişkileri taşır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise güçlüğün karşıtı olan kolaylıktır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; elverişlilik ortaklığı bulunan komşu, dalın yöntem ve uyum sınırını en iyi gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: إتيان الأمر من وجهه، والموافقة والمطاوعة، والترفق للحاجة، وتهيؤ الشيء
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مطلق المجيء بالذات ولا الإعطاء
branches.source_phrase_ar: أتيت الأمر من مأتاته (sihah;maqayis)؛ آتيته على ذلك الأمر مواتاة إذا وافقته وطاوعته (sihah)؛ آتيت فلانا على أمره مؤاتاة وهو حسن المطاوعة (maqayis)؛ تأتى له الشيء أي تهيأ (sihah)؛ تأتى فلان لحاجته إذا ترفق لها (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi su için yol açma ve akışı yöneltme eylemlerini, su kanalı adını ve bir açıklamada akışı tutan birikintiyi açıkça içerir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Su yolu ve akışı kolaylaştırma çekirdektir; akışı tutan odun ya da yaprak birikintisi kaynakça sınırlı bir yan kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Su yolu adı ile suya yol açmayı bildiren kalıp ayrılır; akışı tutan birikinti yalnız biçimin özel kapsamındadır.

concept_map.definition: Suyun akacağı kanal veya suya bir yol açarak akışını kolaylaştırıp yönlendirmedir. Bir kaynakta aynı ad, nehirde birikip suyu tutan odun ve yapraklar için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Su için açılan veya suyu araziye taşıyan bir kanal bulunur.
Suyun akacağı yol kolaylaştırılır ve akış belirli bir yöne çevrilir.
Bir açıklamada nehirdeki odun ve yaprak birikintisinin suyu tutması adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt su kanalı ile suyun akışına yol açma anlamlarını birleştirir; akışı tutan birikinti aynı toplu iddia içindeki sınırlı bir karşı kullanımdır.

concept_gloss.text: su kanalı açmak ve akışı yönlendirmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem suyu taşıyan yol hem de bu yolu açıp akışı kolaylaştırma kavramsal olarak birlikte verileceğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Su kanalı, yol açma ve akışı yönlendirme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Suyu araziye veya havuza taşıyan somut su yolu adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Suyu taşıyan kanal anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Akışı kolaylaştırma eylemini ve suyu tutan birikinti kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: su kanalı; suyu tutan odun ve yaprak birikintisi
bu suya yol açıp akışını yönlendirmek

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal su dışında süt ve ilik için de kullanılan akış yollarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal suyu taşıyan ve toprağı sulayan bir kanal anlamında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal suya özgü yol açma eylemiyle bağlantılıdır; komşu dal ise farklı sıvıların geçitlerini kapsayan daha geniş bir kanal adıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; sulama kanalı komşusu somut yol ile akışı yöneltme eylemi arasındaki sınırı en iyi belirginleştirdi.
branches.what_is_ar: الجدول أو النهر إلى الحوض، وتسهيل جريان الماء أو توجيه مجراه، وما يقع في النهر فيحبس الماء عند مقاييس

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynakların tümü, yağmurun düştüğü başka bir yerden yağmur almamış bölgeye ulaşan seli veya kendi yatağında dışarıdan geçip gelen seli tanımlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız dışarıdaki yağış alanından gelen sel kalıbına bağlıdır; genel sel veya genel akış değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız belirtilen sel nitelemesine bağlı tutulur ve sözcükten genel bir yalın anlam türetilmez.

concept_map.definition: Yağmur alan başka bir bölgeden, yağmur almamış bir bölgeye yatağı boyunca ulaşıp geçen seldir.

facets.statement: Selin suyu yağmur alan başka bir bölgeden gelir.
Sel, kendi yağmurunu almamış bir bölgeye ulaşıp oradan geçer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yerel yağıştan doğmayan ve yağmur alan başka bir yerden geçerek gelen sel sınırında birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Selin ulaştığı yerde yağmur yağmamış, su başka bir yağış alanından gelmişse kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Selin dışarıdaki yağış alanından gelmesi koşulunu korur.

error_profile.adds: Yerel yağmurdan doğan selleri de kapsayarak zorunlu dış kaynak koşulunu kaldırır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal her türlü su akışını, akıtmayı, akan suyu ve akış yerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da yatakta ilerleyen akan su bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kaynağı ve hedef bölgenin yağış durumuyla sınırlı özel bir sel türüdür; komşu dal genel akış alanıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel su akışı dalı, bu kalıbın dışarıdan gelme koşulunu en açık biçimde gösterdi.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الأتي السيل بعينه يأتيك من بلد مطر من غير بلدك (jamhara)؛ سيل أتي وأتاوي إذا جاءك ولم يصبك مطره (sihah)؛ المسيل الذي يأتي من بلد قد مطر فيه إلى بلد لم يمطر فيه أتي (tahdhib)؛ السيل المار على وجهه أتي وأتاوي (mufradat)؛ الأتي أيضا السيل الذي يأتي من بلد غير بلدك (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, içinde bulunduğu topluluğa mensup olmayan yabancı erkeği ortak biçimde tanımlar ve dal çerçevesindeki sınırı doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnız bir topluluk içinde onlardan olmayan yabancı kişi nitelemesine bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kişi niteleyen kalıpla sınırlıdır; her gelen kişi veya dışarıdan gelen sel bu kapsama alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluk içinde bulunan, fakat o topluluğa mensup olmayan yabancı erkektir.

facets.statement: Kişi bir topluluğun içinde bulunur ancak o topluluktan değildir.
Kişi topluluğa göre yabancı ve dışarıdan gelmiş sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin bulunduğu topluluğa mensup olmaması ve bu nedenle yabancı sayılması üzerinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin içinde bulunduğu topluluğun mensubu olmadığını belirtmek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluk içinde bulunma ve ona mensup olmama sınırını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: içinde bulunduğu topluluğa mensup olmayan yabancı adam

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin gruba göre dışarıdan oluşunu korur.
error_profile.adds: Bir topluluk içinde bulunmayan kişiler ile tanınmayan şeyleri de kapsayabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin topluluğa yabancı oluşunu bildirir, sonradan karışma biçimini zorunlu kılmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal topluluğa dışarıdan girip ona karışan kişi görünümünü özellikle taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir topluluk içinde o topluluktan olmayan kişiyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal mensubiyet dışılığını merkez alır; komşu dal dışarıdan girme ve topluluğa karışma görünümünü daha belirgin taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; topluluğa karışmış yabancı dalı mensubiyet ile sonradan giriş arasındaki farkı en iyi gösterdi.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كل آت مطلقا ولا السيل الآتي من بلد آخر
branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل أتي وأتاوي وهو الغريب (jamhara)؛ الاتي أيضا والاتاوى الغريب (sihah)؛ إنما هو أتي فينا (tahdhib)؛ به شبه الغريب فقيل أتاوي (mufradat)؛ رجل أتي أي غريب في قوم ليس منهم وأتاوي كذلك (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ekin ve hurmanın ürünü, gelişmesi ve bol verimi ile suyun çoğalmasını destekler. Çalkalanan tulumdan yağın çıkması ise yalnız ayrı kalıbın kaynak ifadesiyle açıklanabilen, çekirdeğe bağlı olmayan bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bitkisel ürün ve artış çekirdektir; suyun çoğalması uzantı, tulumdan yağ çıkması ise ayrı kalıp kullanımıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ürün ve gelişme bildiren biçim, suyun çoğalması ve çalkalanan tulumda yağın belirmesini bildiren kalıptan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Ekin ve hurmanın gelişip ürün vermesi, ürününün ve veriminin bol olmasıdır; suyun çoğalması da bu artış alanına uzanır. Ayrı bir kalıp, çalkalanan tulumda yağın ortaya çıkmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Ekin veya hurma gelişir, ürün verir ve verimi artar.
Suyun miktarı çoğalır.
Ayrı bir kalıpta çalkalanan tulumun yağı ortaya çıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt bitkisel gelişme, ürün ve bol verimi merkez alır; su artışı ve tulum yağının belirmesi farklı kapsamlı kullanımlardır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ekin veya hurmanın gelişmesi, ürün çıkarması ve veriminin artması birlikte anlatılacağında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkisel gelişme, ürün ve bolluk çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ekinin veya hurmanın çıkan ürünü ve yüksek verimi adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, keskinlik veya iş görme gücünün azalmasıyla insanın, hayvanın, rüzgarın ve duyuların yorulmasını aynı çekirdekte toplar. Verilen dal bu ortak güçten düşme sınırını doğru biçimde yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın güçten düşme anlamını kapsar; bineği yorma anlamı ise yalnız belirtilen ettirgen söz öbeğine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın, hayvanın, aracın, organın ya da etkin gücün keskinliğini, dayanma gücünü veya iş görme yetisini yitirerek körelmesi ya da yorulmasıdır. Bineği bu duruma düşürme, ayrıca belirli bir ettirgen söz öbeğinde anlatılır.

facets.statement: Keskinliğin, gücün veya iş görme yetisinin azalması temel anlamdır.
Yürüyen insanın ya da hayvanın yorulması ve kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme veya rüzgarın etkisizleşmesi bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir.
Belirli ettirgen söz öbeği, kişinin bineğini yorup güçten düşürmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yorulma ile keskinliğini veya etkinliğini yitirmeyi ortak bir güçten düşme alanında birleştirir; kullanım insan, hayvan, kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme ve rüzgar gibi farklı taşıyıcılara uzanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Keskinlik, dayanma gücü veya etkinlik kaybının birlikte anlatıldığı dal çekirdeğine uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem körelmeyi hem de yorularak güçten düşmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan veya hayvanın yürüme ve çalışma sonucu güçten düştüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlı taşıyıcının yorulma ve güç kaybını eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıç, dil, bakış veya başka bir etkin yetinin keskinliğini yitirdiği bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Keskinlik ve etkinlik kaybını doğal bir Türkçe karşılıkla korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yürüme sonucunda insanın veya hayvanın yorulup güçten düşmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal bedensel yorgunlukla sınırlıyken bu dal, aynı güç kaybını araçların keskinliği ile dilin ve duyuların etkinliğine de taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kılıç, dil ve rüzgarın etkisizleşmesi bu dalda açıkça yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gücün tümüyle tükenmesi, bıkkınlık ve eldekinin bitmesi komşu dalın ek kapsamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yorgunluk, bakışın zayıflaması ve gücün kesilmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal körelme ile yorulmayı geniş bir taşıyıcı dizisine uygular; komşu dal ise tükenme, kesilme ve bıkkınlık sonucunu daha belirgin kılar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, başkasının bakımına ve geçimine yük olan kişiyi çekirdek yapar; yetim, yakın desteği bulunmayan kişi ve bakmakla yükümlü olunan kimse bu alanda sayılır. Dal kullanılabilir, ancak bütün bu kişileri özleri gereği değersizleştiren bir niteleme gibi okunmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki ağırlık fiziksel ağırlık değil, bir başkasının üstlendiği bakım ve geçim yüküdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad bağımlı kişiyi veya yükü bildirir; akrabaların kişiye yük olması gibi okumalar yalnız verilen söz öbeklerine bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bakımı, geçimi veya taşınması başkasının sorumluluğuna yük olan kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem de ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi gibi geleneksel adlandırmalar ile akrabaların birine bağımlı hale gelmesi bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şeyin bakım, geçim veya taşıma bakımından başkasına yük olması çekirdektir.
Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi kanıta bağlı özel referanslardır.
Taşınan tapınma nesnesi ve geçimi bir kişiye kalan akrabalar, bağımlılık ilişkisinin söz öbeğine bağlı örnekleridir.
Kaynak anlatımında ağır tabiatlı kişi ve başkası adına iş gören kişi de bu adlandırmanın çevresinde anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, geçimi veya bakımı bir başkasının üzerinde kalan bağımlı kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi ve hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi öne çıkan özel durumlar, taşınan nesne ile geçimi üstlenilen akrabalar ise ilişkiyi somutlaştıran kullanımlardır. Bir kaynak, ağır tabiatlı kişiyi ve başkası adına iş gören kişiyi de bu adlandırma çevresinde anar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Geçim, bakım veya taşıma sorumluluğunun başka bir kişiye düştüğü çekirdek ilişkiye uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bağımlı olan tarafı ve yükü üstlenen başka tarafı birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Bakım sorumluluğunu ve bağımlı kişiler topluluğunu açıkça korur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin yakın desteğinden yoksun olma özelliğini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir şeyin olgunlaşıp tamamlanma sürecini değil, var olan bütünün eksiksiz kapsamını bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız yalın kapsam belirleyicisini açıklar; belirli kalıplardan yeni bir temel anlam çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir bütünün parçalarını ya da bir kümenin bireylerini eksiksiz biçimde kapsayan, biçimce tekil olsa da toplu anlam verebilen belirleyicidir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin parçalarının veya bir kümedeki bireylerin hiçbirini dışarıda bırakmadan kapsanması çekirdektir.
Sözcük biçimce tekil kullanılırken anlamca bir topluluğun tamamına yönelebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal eksiksizlik ve tam olma düşüncesinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nicel kapsam kuran bir belirleyicidir; komşu dal ise bir şeyin tamam olma durumu ile tamamlanma eylemini de içerir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه لفظ الكُلّ لضم الأجزاء وإحاطة الشيء أو الذوات، ومعنى التمام في كل البسط ونحوه

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki mirasçı yakınları, uzak soy bağını ve doğrudan değil yan koldan geçen mirası birlikte verir. Dal doğru yöndedir; ancak adın ölen kişi, mirasçı topluluğu, akrabalık türü veya miras ilişkisinin kendisi için kullanılabildiği açık tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ana baba ile çocuk bu sınıfın dışındadır; olumsuz söz öbeği ise yan koldan değil doğrudan hakla miras almayı bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yan kol akrabalığı çekirdeğini korur; doğrudan miras ve uzak kuzenlik okumaları kendi söz öbeklerine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki, özellikle uzak veya yan koldaki yakınlar üzerinden kurulan mirasçılık ve akrabalık ilişkisidir. Ad, böyle bir miras bırakan kişi, bu yolla mirasçı olanlar veya ilişkinin kendisi için kullanılabilir.

facets.statement: Doğrudan üstsoy ve altsoy dışında kalan yan kol veya uzak akrabalık temel sınırdır.
Ad, ana babası ve çocuğu bulunmadan ölen kişiye, onun yan kol mirasçılarına veya bu miras biçimine yönelebilir.
Olumsuz miras söz öbeği doğrudan hakla miras almayı, kuzenlik söz öbeği ise uzak akrabalığı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki mirasçı yakınları, uzak kuzenleri ve yan koldan geçen mirası bir araya getirir. Sözcüğün ölen kişiye mi, mirasçılara mı, akrabalığa mı yoksa mirasa mı yöneldiği bağlama göre değişebilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kuzenlik bağının doğrudan ve yakın olmayan derecesini korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكَلالة للميت أو الوارث أو القرابة التي عدا الوالد والولد، وبنو العم الأباعد، والميراث من عرض لا من قرب مباشر
